title: AI4IA Foundry routine manifest
description: Validation and planning contract for a proposed multi-step routine. scripts/provision-foundry-routine.py validates this design and prints its plan; it does not create or serve a Foundry routine because azure-ai-projects 2.4.0 exposes a trigger-to-existing-agent routine contract, not this steps-based shape. Nothing in this artifact is consumed by the app runtime.

lifecycle.description: Validated design artifact only; not provisioned or served.

name.description: Routine name (lowercase slug; same pattern as the toolbox name).

model.description: Model deployment name the routine runs on (must exist in the project; AI4IA deploys these in foundry.bicep).

toolbox.description: Optional name of the toolbox whose tools the steps reference. Documents that every tool call flows through the APIM-fronted toolbox MCP endpoint (the bridge). Defaults to the toolbox in toolbox.manifest.json.

steps.description: Ordered proposed workflow steps. At least one is required for a meaningful design.

instructions.description: What the model should do in this step.

tools.description: Canonical tool instance names from foundry/toolbox.manifest.json. Semantic validation rejects unknown names.
